stackDivergence.rationale: Host UTF16 strings, Uint8Array and asynchronous ZIP/SAX bindings replace native component streams and generated token transport at the consumed package boundary.

preservedResponsibilities: Native exact named true/false import leaves Any unchanged on invalid lexemes. Export always uses cppu::any2bool, including genuine bool, signed32-compatible numeric fallback and default typed IllegalArgumentException on other types. XML lexical strings and existing SvXMLUnitConverter bind the parser boundary; no substitute UNO values are introduced.
omittedResponsibilities: Native C++ ABI and OUString backing/thread lifetime are not claimed.
Complete document DOCX parsing/export and existing UI integration remain pending in V4DQJW.
